Aurora X2 Espresso Machine Warranty

The Aurora X2 is covered by a limited warranty of two years from the date of purchase. Registering the machine online within 30 days extends the warranty on the pump and boiler to five years.

The warranty covers defects in materials and workmanship under normal household use. It does not cover damage caused by limescale, use of unfiltered hard water, commercial use, or repairs by unauthorised technicians.

Descale the machine every two months using the official descaling solution. Failure to descale voids the warranty for the heating element.

To make a warranty claim, contact the service centre with your serial number and proof of purchase. The serial number is printed on a sticker underneath the drip tray.

Approved claims are repaired or replaced within 14 days. If a repair is not possible, a replacement machine of equal or better specification is provided.
